body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony unveiled its personal Internet viewer 'dash(model: HID-C10)' at CES 2010 held in Las Vegas. With the dash, users can enjoy their favorite parts of the internet customized the way they want.

Choose from your favorite information and entertainment content over 1,000 free apps, then the dash personal Internet viewer connects quickly and easily to your existing wireless network. Adopting a 7-inch LCD touch screen for accessing a variety of video services for online music and viral videos, it supports mp3 playback and internet radio via the built-in stereo speakers or the headphone jack. Suggested price is 199(USD).
